en.title: Words that link
en.summary: Prepositions link a noun to the rest of the sentence, and conjunctions join words and clauses.

paragraphs: Prepositions and conjunctions are the linking words of English. A preposition connects a noun or pronoun to another word and often shows place, time or direction. A conjunction joins words, phrases or whole clauses. Neither class changes its form.

A preposition comes before its noun phrase: on the table, with her. A conjunction either joins equal parts, such as and, but and or, or adds a dependent part, such as because, when and if. A word like after can be a preposition (after dinner) or a conjunction (after we ate).

blocks.html:
ClassExamples
preposition of placein, on, at, under
preposition of timeat, on, in, during
coordinating conjunctionand, but, or, so
subordinating conjunctionbecause, when, if, that
both classesafter, before, since

paragraphs: If the word is followed by a noun phrase, it is a preposition: before the meeting. If it is followed by a clause with its own verb, it is a conjunction: before the meeting started. Words such as before, after and since work in both ways.

In questions and in some relative clauses, English often leaves the preposition at the end: Who did you speak to? This is normal in speech. In very formal writing, to whom did you speak? is also correct.

items: Wrong: **I am agree with you.** Right: **I agree with you.**
Wrong: **Because it rained.** (alone) Right: **I stayed because it rained.**

ro.title: Cuvinte care leagă
ro.summary: Prepozițiile și conjuncțiile sunt cuvinte scurte care leagă cuvinte sau propoziții între ele.

paragraphs: Prepozițiile și conjuncțiile sunt cuvinte de legătură. Prepoziția leagă un substantiv sau un pronume de restul propoziției. Conjuncția unește două cuvinte de același fel sau două propoziții. Aceste cuvinte mici arată relația dintre idei.
Prepoziția stă în fața cuvântului pe care îl leagă. Cele mai multe prepoziții cer cazul acuzativ. Conjuncția stă între părțile pe care le leagă. Aceste cuvinte nu își schimbă niciodată forma.
